title: Monthanus Ratanapakdee
intro:
Monthanus Ratanapakdee is running for election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 2 in California. Ratanapakdee is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ratanapakdee also ran in a special election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 2 in California. Ratanapakdee lost as a write-in in the special general election on June 2, 2026.
Ratanapakdee completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
